name: Mirror Marker
source:
Mirror Marker is a dating sim about Galen, who's an introverted, smart and serious young woman, starting her university life. Her best friend Charlotte worries about her and tells her she often seems to force  a smile. Galen herself  doesn't know why she would appear that way to others.  At the university, she meets three guys who each share one of her flaws: 

- Finn, an ex-classmate from middle school, who has always been the cute and upbeat guy in the round. 
- Rhett, a reliable upperclassman, always happy to help. 
- Hugo, the partying student from IT.

With whom will you bond? Will you be able to help Galen find peace with herself? 

[From [url=https://niasobu.itch.io/mirror-marker-otome-game-jam-prototype]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Mirror Marker》是一款关于盖伦的约会模拟游戏，盖伦是一位内向、聪明、严肃的年轻女性，她即将开始她的大学生活。她最好的朋友夏洛特很担心她，并告诉她她似乎经常强颜欢笑。盖伦自己也不知道为什么自己会在别人面前露出这样的表情。在大学里，她遇到了三个男人，每个人都有她的一个缺点：

- Finn，中学前同学，一直是大家眼中可爱、乐观的家伙。
- 瑞德，一位可靠的高年级生，总是乐于助人。
- Hugo，IT学院的派对学生。

你会和谁建立联系？你能帮助盖伦找到内心的平静吗？

[来自[url=https://niasobu.itch.io/mirror-marker-otome-game-jam-prototype]Itch.io[/url]]
